personality_one_liner: An industrial, function-first logistics command center prioritizing operational clarity, hard alignments, and uncompromised utilitarian aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, and exposed structural dividers. Padding is generous but sharp. Avoid soft margins; align text flush to strict guides. No half-width orphans; modules fill the viewport width.

dont's: No blur or glass anywhere. Use solid colors and 1.5pt hard borders for structural separation and layering.

screens.name: Home (Customer)
screens.purpose: Command center for the shipper to view active loads and rapidly initiate new requests.

states.loading: Centered industrial loading text 'SYNCING_SYSTEM...' in IBM Plex Mono.
states.empty: No active shipments. Illustration or empty warehouse image, with full-width primary CTA.
states.error: Hard red error block with mono typography: 'CONNECTION REFUSED' and bold retry button.

screens.layout: Fixed header with user context. The rest is a modular ListView. Large, edge-to-edge cards for active loads featuring oversized metric typography (weight, ETA) and thick bottom borders. Primary 'Post Shipment' CTA is sticky at the bottom, full width, zero radius, hard border.

screens.name: Load Board (Truck Owner)
screens.purpose: Feed of available shipments emphasizing payout, distance, and quick quoting actions.

states.loading: Full-screen structural skeleton using high-contrast alternating grey bands.
states.empty: Empty highway background with scrim. 'NO LOADS IN PERIMETER'.
states.error: Error state block occupying the primary feed area.

screens.layout: Sticky filter rails (segmented controls, squared off) under the header. Feed contains densely packed, highly structured cards. Each card uses internal horizontal dividers, left-aligned mono labels for dimensions/goods type, and a high-contrast 'SUBMIT QUOTE' action.

screens.name: Post Shipment
screens.purpose: A mechanical, step-by-step or continuous long-scroll form to define shipment details.

states.error: Inline validation in signal red, hard squared borders turning red.

screens.layout: Single column. Edge-to-edge horizontal lines separating form groups. Labels sit starkly above inputs in mono font. Inputs have sharp borders. 'CONTINUE' CTA is sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Tracking & Timeline
screens.purpose: Live operational tracking surface for a shipment in transit.
screens.layout: Top half is the map (or abstracted location view). Bottom half is an edge-to-edge sheet featuring a vertical structural timeline. Bold, oversized status headers (e.g., 'IN TRANSIT'). Strict adherence to mono typography for timestamps and location coordinates.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 5 Brutalist Mobile rules: ZERO border radius across the app (buttons, cards, inputs are sharp squares).
Do NOT use glassmorphism, blur, or soft shadows. Depth is created using 1.5pt hard borders (borderStrong) and stark contrast.
Fonts: Use 'Archivo' for all display headings and 'IBM Plex Mono' for body text, metadata, form labels, and timestamps. This enforces the mechanical/industrial look.
Colors: Ensure #EA580C (Industrial Orange) is used as the sole accent for primary actions against the stark monochrome base. NEVER use blue, purple, or indigo.
Layout: Use edge-to-edge containers separated by thick dividers. Avoid 'floating' cards. Cards should span 100% width with flush borders.

CTAs: Primary buttons MUST be sticky at the bottom of forms/lists, completely full width, with no margins on the sides (edge-to-edge) if at the screen root, or respecting safe horizontal padding but filling it fully.

Images: Always apply a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) when rendering text on images. Use the provided truck/warehouse images for headers, empty states, and profile backgrounds.
